title: Time and control code for video tape recorders, Part 2: Vertical-Interval Time Code (VITC)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard (Part 2) specifies the format and modulation method to be employed when using the verticaf-interval time-and-control code for timing and control purposes on television tapemachines for recordings made in accordance with the 625-lines/50-fields television system. It also specifies the location of the code within the television signal and its relationship to the longitudinal time-and-control code for television tape recordings defined in Parti. This standard is applicable for 50 Hz 625 lines system.
clause_3_terminology: Time and control code for video tape recorders

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
